final: WITH source_stats AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG(1.0 * s.boxy / s.boxz) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), kept AS (SELECT * FROM source_stats WHERE record_count > (SELECT AVG(record_count) FROM source_stats)) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_ratio, SUM(record_count) AS total_spatial_records, AVG(record_count - (SELECT AVG(record_count) FROM source_stats)) AS average_excess_count FROM kept
